Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 72

“This is the state of Brahman, Partha. Having attained it, one is not deluded. Established in it even at the last hour, one reaches the peace of Brahman.”

The chapter ends generously — even at the last hour. Krishna leaves the door open to those who arrive late, a quiet reassurance after seventy verses of demanding description.
